dedupe_keys.name: geomolg national geospatial web mapping application of the palestinian ministry of local government

description: GeoMOLG is the national geospatial web mapping application of the Palestinian Ministry of Local Government, offering a wide range of maps linked to attribute tables. The viewer's introduction read on 2026-09-28 says the system is owned by the ministry and was developed in-house by a team of engineers with support from the German development agency GIZ, that it went into use for ministry departments in May 2013 and opened to the public in January 2017, and that it is enhanced regularly by improving data accuracy and adding tools and services; it recommends checking other sources before important decisions. Coverage is the Palestinian territories administered by local councils. Access is free in the browser; no licence or download is stated. Caveats: the layer list was not captured in the headless session, and accuracy varies by layer, as the ministry itself warns. It supports reference layers for hazard exposure and network studies of Palestinian localities, such as master plans, roads and local infrastructure. Related records: data-palestine-completed-buildings-by-use-2017-census and data-pwa-palestine-water-sector-facts-and-figures complement it.
